unverified: Untagged residential, living street, service, unclassified, and tertiary roads are assumed 25 mph. A tertiary road posted above the cap would show as legal until a sign or a DOT speed is added. Those roads are listed for a person to check. A posted sign still wins.

enforcement.note: Searched the town ordinance index and the web for a Boothbay Harbor golf cart or LSV ban. None was found. Plain golf carts stay off mainland public roads under 29-A M.R.S. section 501(2-A). LSVs follow section 2089: roads posted 35 mph or less.

_dot_all_classes: State speed regulations cover local streets, so match them on every road class.
